title: Coordenador De Logística

description:
Vaga de Trabalho

    após efetivação: 3,5 salários-mínimos;
    evolução conforme Planode Carreira.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Bacharelado em Direito;
  • Experiência na área de proteção de dados, de no mínimo 1 ano;
  • Ao menos uma certificação EXIN, ITCerts ou IAPP;
  • Boa redação técnica;
  • Capacidade decomunicação com clientes;
  • Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalho remoto;
  • Interesse real por LGPD, compliance e segurança da informação;
  • Alinhamento com a Cultura ICNR (“fit cultural”). Para saber se você tem isso, leia nosso Código de Cultura

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Trilhas completas de certificação;
  • Pós-graduaçãoem área relacionada;
  • Experiência com cartórios (serventias extrajudiciais);
  • Participação em eventos, cursos, treinamentos na área;
  • Publicações técnicas.

Etapas do processo seletivo

O processo seletivo será realizado em quatro etapas:

  1. Triagem de currículos.
  2. Preenchimento de formulários de múltipla escolha para mensurar conhecimento técnico, alinhamento cultural e perfil DISC.
  3. Resposta a questionário breve com perguntas abertas e discursivas.
  4. Entrevistas.

A seleção buscará avaliar não apenas o conhecimento técnico, mas também o alinhamento com a cultura do ICNR, a maturidade profissional, a capacidade de entrega, a comunicação e a aderência à rotina consultiva.

Quem somos

O ICNR é uma consultoria especializada no atendimento a cartórios e empresas, com atuação majoritária em proteção de dados. Também desenvolvemos projetos de compliance anticorrupção, antissuborno, prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro e segurança da informação.

Embora também atue com empresas, o principal eixo de trabalho do ICNR está no setor extrajudicial, no qual já atendemos mais de 160 cartórios em 20 estados, com reconhecimento construído tanto no mercado quanto em espaços institucionais ligados à atividade notarial e registral.

A equipe do ICNR reúne profissionais com experiência prática, produção técnica e atuação autoral na área. Para novos consultores, a oportunidade envolve crescimento profissional em temas regulatórios complexos, contato com clientes exigentes e participação em entregas que exigem estudo, responsabilidade, boa comunicação e compromisso com qualidade.

O que esperamos

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Jurídico em Proteção de Dados e Compliance, em nível pleno, para integrar nossa equipe em regime CLT e modalidade home office.

A pessoa selecionada atuará em projetos consultivos, elaboração de documentos técnicos, atendimento a clientes, treinamentos, reuniões, análise de riscos, apoio em demandas relacionadas à LGPD, segurança da informação e compliance, na maior parte das vezes para atender clientes do nicho de cartórios extrajudiciais.

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em proteção de dados e/ou compliance, raciocínio jurídico-prático, capacidade de organização e gestão de projetos, além de boa escrita e comunicação clara com clientes.

Acima de tudo, buscamos alguém com vontade de trabalhar, que ame a área de proteção de dados e que queira se desenvolver nela.

title: Fincrime Analyst (Investigations) - Brazil
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.

To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes

What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.G., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends

Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.G., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.

We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Global Payroll & Compensation Specialist

-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, Carnegie, Flywire, YipitData, Niche, and BellXcel.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.

You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.

Who we're looking for

Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.

What you'll own

  • Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard

What you bring

Nice to have

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Head Of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.

About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.

Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.

Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.G., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.

P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Member Of The Board Of Advisors
description:
About the Company

Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.

Company Website:

About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors

Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.

We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Compensation & Benefits

This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Why Join Us

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham , our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Process And Automation Consultant (3 Months)
description:
We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‑month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‑to‑end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points, and design automation‑ready future‑state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams, the client’s internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Document current‑state end‑to‑end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‑discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‑based validation) and assess their long‑term viability. Design future‑state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‑making.

✅ Job Requirements

Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‑automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‑stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable

techniques. Hands‑on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‑functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates.

Preferred Skills

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‑to‑cash operations. Exposure to process‑mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‑orchestration platforms (e.G., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

title: Ux Designer
description:
UX Designer (Physical Products & DTC Experience)

Carepod is a premium home wellness brand focused on creating thoughtfully designed consumer products that improve everyday life.

We’re looking for a UX Designer to help us create intuitive, customer-centered experiences across our physical products and digital customer journey. This role combines product usability, customer research, website UX, and customer experience , helping shape everything from product interactions to online purchasing and onboarding.

You’ll work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, and HQ to transform customer insights into better products and better experiences.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys owning projects, collaborating across teams, and making a measurable impact on how customers experience our brand.

What You’ll Do

Product UX & Customer Research

  • Conduct product usability testing and customer research
  • Analyze customer reviews, support conversations, surveys, and behavioral insights
  • Identify friction points and recommend customer-focused improvements
  • Build personas, journey maps, and usability documentation

Website UX

  • Improve website and e-commerce user experience
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and UX recommendations
  • Partner with Marketing to optimize customer education and conversion
  • Improve online product presentation and navigation

Product Experience

  • Improve packaging, onboarding, and instructional materials
  • Collaborate with Product Development on customer-centered product improvements
  • Support user testing for new products and accessories
  • Ensure consistency across physical and digital customer touch points

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, and HQ
  • Present research findings and UX recommendations
  • Help coordinate initiatives that improve the overall customer experience

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help us:

  • Deliver more intuitive customer experiences
  • Improve website usability and customer conversion
  • Reduce customer confusion and support contacts
  • Improve packaging and onboarding experiences
  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product improvements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field
  • Experience with direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands
  • Strong UX research and usability testing experience
  • Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and journey maps
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects
  • Strong attention to detail and customer-first mindset

Nice to Have

  • Customer Experience (CX) background
  • Packaging or unboxing design experience
  • Experience with consumer products or home appliances
  • Shopify or Amazon experience
  • Experience improving product onboarding or customer education

Tools

  • Figma
  • Adobe Creative Suite

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Someone who enjoys solving customer problems through thoughtful design
  • Someone who likes balancing research and execution
  • Someone who works well independently while collaborating across teams
  • Someone who enjoys fast-moving environments and high ownership

Who May Not Be a Fit

  • Someone interested only in UI for software products
  • Someone uncomfortable working across multiple business functions
  • Someone who requires highly structured processes and close supervision

title: Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture.
  • Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud.
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.
  • Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.
  • APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.
  • Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.
  • Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.
  • OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes complexos, priorizando, negociando escopo e sustentando a relação ao longo do projeto
  • Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes complexos de ponta a ponta, com autonomia para priorizar, negociar escopo e sustentar a relação depois que o projeto vira. O cliente continua sendo seu
  • Monitorar o risco de cada conta com método, olhando adoção da plataforma, frequência de uso, troca de interlocutor e sinais de insatisfação. Risco identificado cedo é problema resolvido, risco identificado tarde é cliente perdido

O queprecisamos que você tenha

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala
  • Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto
  • IA aplicada a finanças: você vai estar perto do que existe de mais atual. Estamos construindo isso na prática, com quem entende de contabilidade participando das decisões, não recebendo o resultado pronto

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

A Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. title: Professor De Francês

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.

A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.

Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.

Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução;
    realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos;
    remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas;
    utilizar os insights devendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:

  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!

Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.

Oferecemos

  • Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível.
  • Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas.
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.

VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.

Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.

Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades

A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

title: Segment Manager
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager

Department: Sales — Latin America

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions.
  • Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution.
  • Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages.
  • Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities.
  • Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs.
  • Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, IoT hardware, or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business.
  • Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, IoT modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations.
  • Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.G., ANATEL, IFT).

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:

  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics
  • Smart agriculture
  • Smart cities and infrastructure
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Connected mobility and automotive
  • Smart home and consumer IoT

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at, or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Data Specialist (With Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions;
    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets;
    familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Director Of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required;
    Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required;
    English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum;
    MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

description:
Pioneirismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Muito além de uma divulgação de vaga, este é um convite para você fazer parte de uma história pioneira, que une inovação, responsabilidade socioambiental e relevância estratégica no cenário global da mineração de terras raras.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

As inscrições também estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), mulheres e grupos prioritários, em conformidade com os princípios de inclusão e equidade.

Como você poderá contribuir?

Operando e monitorando remotamente as unidades da planta de beneficiamento (peneiramento, lixiviação, precipitação, filtração e sistemas de reagentes), garantindo o controle dos parâmetros do processo.

Registrar indicadores operacionais (massa alimentada, umidade, vazão, % de sólidos, concentração de NaCl, pH, entre outros) em planilhas de produção para suporte à gestão.

Acompanhar o desempenho dos processos, identificando e corrigindo desvios por meio de ajustes remotos nos equipamentos.

Manter comunicação contínua com a equipe operacional para acionamentos, paradas e substituições de componentes.

Reportar à supervisão falhas eletromecânicas e desvios operacionais, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões.

Zelar pela conservação de equipamentos e pela organização do ambiente de trabalho, respeitando normas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente.

Apoiar a liderança na análise de problemas e na definição de ações corretivas.
